basic_details.job_title: CUTN Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN) has officially announced the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://cutn.ac.in. Candidates who are up to 28 years of age (age relaxation applicable as per Government of India rules) and hold an M.Sc., M.Tech., Integrated M.Sc., or BS-MS in Applied Geology, Geology, Geophysics, Geodesy, Geoinformatics, or an equivalent degree with the required marks and a valid CSIR/UGC-NET/GATE score can submit their online applications up to 08-08-2026. qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc./ M.Tech. / Integrated M.Sc. / BS-MS in Applied Geology, Geology, Geophysics, Geodesy, Geoinformatics
qualification.details: M.Sc./ M.Tech. / Integrated M.Sc. / BS-MS in Applied Geology, Geology, Geophysics, Geodesy, Geoinformatics, or equivalent degree from a recognized university, institute, and R&D labs. 60% marks for General/OBC. 55% for SC/ST/PH. Valid CSIR/UGC-NET/GATE score. Experience processing and analyzing GNSS/GPS, InSAR data, tectonic deformation processes in seismically active regions, and a basic understanding of programming (Linux, Python, MATLAB, or similar) for data analysis and modelling is desirable.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUTN to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: CUTN JRF Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.Sc./ M.Tech. / Integrated M.Sc. / BS-MS in Applied Geology, Geology, Geophysics, Geodesy, Geoinformatics, or equivalent degree from a recognized university, institute, and R&D labs. 60% marks for General/OBC. 55% for SC/ST/PH. Valid CSIR/UGC-NET/GATE score. Experience processing and analyzing GNSS/GPS, InSAR data, tectonic deformation processes in seismically active regions, and a basic understanding of programming (Linux, Python, MATLAB, or similar) for data analysis and modelling is desirable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at CUTN?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow position at Central University of Tamil Nadu is 08-08-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./ M.Tech. / Integrated M.Sc. / BS-MS degree in Applied Geology, Geology, Geophysics, Geodesy, Geoinformatics, or an equivalent degree from a recognized institution with the specified marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is a valid CSIR/UGC-NET/GATE score mandatory for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a valid CSIR/UGC-NET/GATE score will only be considered for the Junior Research Fellow position at CUTN.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at CUTN?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the Google Form provided, and a copy of the application should be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will involve an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Does CUTN offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided to candidates belonging to reserved categories as per the rules of the Government of India.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at the Central University of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: The official notification and application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article, along with a link to the official CUTN website.
